mapper.sql: SELECT p.result_id, w.work_order_id, w.order_no, i.item_id, i.item_code, i.item_name, w.planned_qty, p.good_qty, p.defect_qty, p.defect_reason, p.recorded_at, g.receipt_id, g.received_at FROM production_result p JOIN work_order w ON w.work_order_id = p.work_order_id JOIN item i ON i.item_id = w.item_id LEFT JOIN goods_receipt g ON g.result_id = p.result_id
mapper.update: {call complete_work(#{orderId, mode=IN, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{request.goodQty, mode=IN, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{request.defectQty, mode=IN, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{request.defectReason, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR})}
